entries.name: BSc General
requirements: A bachelor’s pass on the National Senior Certificate (NSC) is required.
Use your English Home Language or First Additional Language mark.
Wits required both National Benchmark Tests (Academic and Quantitative Literacy, and Mathematics) by 31 October 2026.
Wits could consider applicants on 40–41 APS for the waiting list if places were available.
